other_conditions: First two children from a family where a parent is a factory worker must be registered
Applicants must score more than 75% marks in their examination
Beneficiaries become eligible for benefits after 90 days of registration
Applicant should be studying in class 10th, 12th, graduate, post‑graduate or selected courses
benefits_summary: Cash incentives ranging from ₹5,000 for class 10th/12th up to ₹12,500 for vocational/professional courses, plus reimbursement of admission fees, hostel, food and an annual Rs 2,000 for books and stationery.
